title: FastAPI documentation study note: HTTPException
text: In FastAPI, import HTTPException from fastapi. Raise HTTPException to stop processing a request and return an HTTP error response. An HTTPException can specify a status_code and a detail value. The detail value may contain JSON-serializable data. Raising an exception differs from returning it.

title: FastAPI documentation study note: response status codes
text: FastAPI path operation decorators accept the status_code parameter to declare the response HTTP status code. A 201 status code denotes a created resource. A 204 status code denotes no content and must not have a response body. These are framework documentation notes, not configuration facts about the demo service.

title: Fictional EvidenceOps demo service: diagnostic policy
text: This is a fictional policy fixture. The planned demo service allows operator-role users to request read-only health diagnostics. Reader-role users cannot execute diagnostic tools. Shell commands, restarts and configuration changes are not permitted. No diagnostic tools are implemented in this starter, so documentation cannot establish whether the service is healthy right now.
